method: Built-in image_gen edits using actual Pinterest reference image files
scope: One distinct reference scene per section; options reuse that section scene. Illustrations are not measured optical simulations or previews of the user subject.

entries.credit: Jamie Hawkesworth Pays Homage to Joan Didion; domain-verified W Magazine Pinterest account links to the W Magazine article.
entries.scene: A winding path between golden coastal grass mounds.
entries.prompt: Use the supplied Pinterest photo as the ACTUAL EDIT TARGET, not merely inspiration. Produce ONE photographic comparison texture atlas: EXACT equal grid cells touching edge-to-edge with ZERO gutters, margins, borders, captions, numbers, text overlays or logos. Each cell is a complete LANDSCAPE 3:2 photographic view. High-quality material texture and authentic fine detail, maximum useful output resolution. The ORIGINAL PLACE and original objects must remain unmistakably recognizable in every cell. Keep unmentioned details fixed. Do not invent unrelated architecture, people or subject matter. AI illustration only, not evidence of measured optical properties. EXACT3columns2rows overallwide9:4aspect. Keep THIS winding dark path between dense tufted golden grass mounds under the pale blue sky, the same mound silhouettes, horizon and camera composition. Six creative-language treatments across this same reference place. Row1left DREAMY MINIMALISM: pale restrained light, soft gentle distance, quieter reduced palette and fine grass, subtle dreamlike stillness. Row1middle BRUTALIST POETRY: raw weighty masses of the existing grass mounds, decisive high-contrast raking light, mineral neutrals, strong path geometry; no new concrete buildings. Row1right CYBERPUNK AFTER HOURS: the same landscape at dark blue hour, restrained cyan/amber light accents grazing the existing grass and path, moody technological color language without adding structures/signs. Row2left PLAYFUL MAXIMALISM: richer layered grass colors and wildflower accents, expressive density yet recognizable path/mounds. Row2middle TACTILE SURREALISM: the same grass becomes exceptionally soft and velvety, rounded hand-worked tactile treatment, warm earthen colors, subtle not cartoonish. Row2right GRAPHIC COLOR POP: visually simple sculptural masses of the same mounds with a sharp cobalt/orange color relationship and precise authored shadows. Same landscape, not six unrelated scenes. Preserve reference-specific path shape and fine texture throughout.
entries.note: Reference-derived AI variation; not an optical measurement. Unseen scene geometry is inferred where viewpoints change.
entries.inspection: Visually inspected: recognizable golden grass/path/mound geometry retained. Six creative treatments present. Native atlas cells are square, not requested3:2; UI must use natural cell aspect. Creative-language interpretation is illustrative.
